description: This source file defines a function to order a list of files based on their relative paths with respect to a root directory. It includes a data structure 'orderedFile' used internally to hold file path information, and the main 'orderFiles' function that performs the ordering.

classes.name: orderedFile
classes.description: A simple data structure holding the absolute and relative paths of a file for internal processing in the file ordering function.

methods.name: orderFiles
methods.description: Orders a list of file paths based on their paths relative to a specified root directory, returning a sorted list. It handles errors related to obtaining absolute and relative paths.
